title: Digital Signal Processing
tagline: The DFT and FFT, FIR and IIR filter design, filter structures, multirate processing and spectral analysis
summary: Digital signal processing computes with sampled signals. This course develops the discrete Fourier transform and the fast algorithms that compute it, the design of FIR and IIR digital filters, their realisation with finite precision, multirate systems, and the estimation of spectra from data.

chapters.title: Discrete-time signals and systems
chapters.summary: Sequences, difference equations, convolution, the DTFT and the z-transform from a DSP viewpoint.

chapters.title: The discrete Fourier transform
chapters.summary: The DFT, its relation to the DTFT, circular convolution and linear filtering with the DFT.

chapters.title: The fast Fourier transform
chapters.summary: Decimation-in-time and decimation-in-frequency FFTs, computational cost and practical implementation.

chapters.title: FIR filter design
chapters.summary: Linear phase, the window method, frequency sampling and optimal equiripple design.

chapters.title: IIR filter design
chapters.summary: Analog prototypes, impulse invariance and the bilinear transform.

chapters.title: Filter structures and finite precision
chapters.summary: Direct, cascade, parallel and lattice structures, coefficient quantisation and round-off noise.

chapters.title: Multirate signal processing
chapters.summary: Decimation, interpolation, polyphase implementations and filter banks.

chapters.title: Spectral analysis
chapters.summary: Windowing, the periodogram, averaging methods and the short-time Fourier transform.
